title: Transfer an Australian Defence Force driver/rider licence
summary: Learn how to apply for a NSW driver or rider licence if you currently hold an Australian Defence Force (ADF) licence.
intro: If you live in NSW and hold an Australian Defence Force (ADF) driver or rider licence, you can only use that licence while performing your duties. When driving/riding for other purposes, you'll need to apply for a NSW driver/rider licence.
who_can_apply: You live in NSW and hold an Australian Defence Force (ADF) driver or rider licence.
You are applying for a NSW driver/rider licence for purposes other than performing ADF duties.
what_you_need: Your ADF driver or rider licence
Verification of your ADF licence from the relevant authority
Completion of all normal licence requirements

how_to_steps.text: Request your ADF authority to provide verification of your defence force licence to your preferred Service NSW Centre.
Make sure you have all your documentation and any additional items (glasses/contact lenses).
Visit the relevant service centre and submit your application.

more_info.text: You have 30 days to visit a service centre after the ADF has provided verification of your defence force licence to the service centre.
Interstate ADF personnel and their dependants, can use their interstate driver licence until it expires, but must carry their defence force issued driver ID with them at all times.

Overseas defence force personnel, and their dependants, can drive without a NSW driver licence for up to 6 months. You must carry your current overseas driver licence (with an English translation if not in English) or International Driving Permit (IDP) with you at all times.
Renewal notices are mailed generally within 6 weeks of the card's expiry date giving you plenty of time to plan ahead and renew early.
For driver licence renewals or applications, a receipt is provided that allows you to drive until the card arrives in the post. The receipt is valid for 2 months.

faqs.q: When can I use my ADF licence?
faqs.a: You can only use your ADF licence while performing your duties.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for a NSW licence?
faqs.a: You need your ADF licence, verification of it from the relevant authority, proof of identity, and payment.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my application?
faqs.a: You must visit a relevant Service NSW Centre to submit your application.
